articles.title: Trump signs narrower executive order on AI oversight after industry objections
articles.summary: After industry objections, President Trump signed a revised AI executive order requiring only voluntary prerelease government reviews of advanced models.

articles.title: Anthropic scales Claude Mythos  to critical infrastructure in 15+ countries
articles.summary: Anthropic is expanding Project Glasswing, its security vulnerability program, and access to Mythos to 150 organizations across 15 countries — targeting critical infrastructure in power, water, healthcare, and communications where a cyberattack could affect 100 million people.

articles.title: Rocket engine startup Impulse raises $500 million to hire people, not AI
articles.summary: Engineering physical systems still depends on human talent, according to Impulse Space president Eric Romo.

articles.title: Alphabet plans to raise $80B to pay for AI buildout
articles.summary: "The company is experiencing strong demand for its AI solutions and services from enterprises and consumers, at levels that are exceeding the company’s available supply," Alphabet said in its statement.

articles.summary: If Nvidia has cracked a way to bring AI agents easily, safely, and usefully to the masses, it could — and should — be big.

articles.title: Florida sues OpenAI, Sam Altman, in first-of-its-kind lawsuit over violent incidents
articles.summary: The lawsuit partially revolves around a shooting at Florida State University last year, and ChatGPT's alleged role in the incident.

articles.title: This AI weather startup is out-forecasting government agencies
articles.summary: WindBorne benefits from its unique combination of model-building and data collection. The company now has about 400 balloons in flight gathering sensor readings at any given time, launched from 15 sites around the globe. The advances in its current model come from improvements in how the data collected by the balloons is fed into the models.

articles.title: Gemini’s new AI agent is about as good as Google’s demo
articles.summary: Google's new "24/7" AI agent, Gemini Spark, can be shockingly good at doing things on your behalf. But I'm not sure it's worth the financial cost and potential privacy tradeoffs. The company gave me access to Spark last week. Google advertises Spark as an AI agent that can take on tasks and work on them […]

articles.title: Meta’s own AI was exploited to hijack Instagram accounts
articles.summary: Meta's AI support chatbot helped hackers hijack Instagram accounts, as reported earlier by 404 Media. articles.title: Strava blames zero-code AI apps and scrapers as it tightens API access
articles.summary: The popular fitness-tracking platform, Strava, is restricting access to its API as part of efforts to clamp down on AI scraping, as reported earlier by TechCrunch. articles.title: Uber caps employee AI spending after blowing through budget in 4 months
articles.summary: Uber's cutback has occurred after the company had reportedly encouraged staff to use AI as much as possible.

articles.title: Martin Scorsese becomes the latest — and most unlikely — Hollywood voice for AI
articles.summary: The caveat is that one of the world's most famous living directors is using the tech solely for storyboarding.

articles.title: Google rolls out fake call detection to protect against AI deepfake impersonation scams
articles.summary: As people increasingly refuse to answer calls from unknown numbers, scammers are shifting their tactics by spoofing trusted phone numbers and using AI deepfake technology to sound like authority figures, family members, or employers.

articles.title: Amazon faces class action lawsuit over Ring facial-recognition feature
articles.summary: The class action lawsuit, filed in Seattle by Virginia resident Charles Sigwalt, claims that Ring's Familiar Faces feature stores images of passersby without consent.

articles.title: OpenAI launches new Codex tools for white-collar work
articles.summary: OpenAI released a set of six plug-ins aimed at specific jobs: data analytics, creative production, sales, product design, equity investing, and investment banking. Available from within the Codex app, each of the new tools bundles integrations, instructions, and context to allow Codex to approximate a specific job.
